note: Copilot & AI #12. Needs the throwaway VM CON-ARC01 (Windows Server 2025 Datacenter Evaluation, Desktop Experience, 2 vCPU / 4 GB / 60 GB, MGLab-NAT, 10.50.0.45, not domain-joined, see series/LAB-REQUESTS.md). It is not created here. The kit credential must be valid for PowerShell Direct on CON-ARC01 (a non-domain VM needs its local Administrator: if the CONTOSO\ prefix is rejected the whatif scene cannot connect). No shared VM is changed. Never enable Windows Server management benefits, Essential Machine Management, Defender, Update Manager or any extension. Copilot's drafts are saved by the owner in the episode out folder (copilot-draft.ps1, copilot-change.ps1, copilot-nowhatif.ps1). A screen that needs a second capture of another kind lists it under 'then'.
prepare: Invoke-Command -Session $s { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force C:\lab | Out-Null; Remove-Item C:\lab\ep12 -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

if (-not (Invoke-Command -Session $s { Test-Path 'C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe' })) { if (-not (Test-Path $msi)) { Invoke-WebRequest "https://github.com/PowerShell/PowerShell/releases/download/v$v/PowerShell-$v-win-x64.msi" -OutFile $msi }; Copy-Item -ToSession $s -Path $msi -Destination C:\lab\pwsh.msi -Force; Invoke-Command -Session $s { Start-Process msiexec.exe '/i C:\lab\pwsh.msi /quiet ADD_PATH=1 ENABLE_PSREMOTING=1' -Wait } }
Push-Location src; pwsh -NoProfile -File Invoke-AdminGate.ps1 scripts/Get-ServerHealth.ps1 -SkipResolution; Pop-Location
az group create --name rg-mglab-copilot-ai-12 --location westeurope -o none

# manual (owner, on CON-ARC01): sign in as local Administrator (typed off camera), run the Azure Arc Setup wizard from the Start menu and connect to the resource group; wait for Connected in the portal; evaluation edition may not be accepted by Arc: say so on camera and use a licensed or Azure VM instead

# manual (owner): scratch repo with src\copilot-config\copilot-instructions.md copied to .github\copilot-instructions.md, opened in VS Code; clear old Copilot chats, one conversation per prompt; confirm the GitHub Copilot plan

screens.name: arc-onboard
steps: Show CON-ARC01 with operating system Windows Server 2025, status Connected and resource group rg-mglab-copilot-ai-12

then.name: arc-setup-wizard
then.app: Azure Arc Setup wizard on CON-ARC01 (Hyper-V console)
steps: Only for the take where the agent is installed: Start menu, Azure Arc Setup, walk through the wizard to the connection step
Sign-in prompts are typed or approved by the owner off camera
mask: subscription id and tenant id in the wizard

screens.name: azure-copilot
steps: Open the Copilot pane in the portal
Ask: List my Azure Arc-enabled servers and their agent status
Ask (a new conversation): Help me troubleshoot my Arc server extension (Learn's own sample)
Capture the real answers, also if vague or wrong, and any request for a resource ID or any limits message
Optional take: ask Write a Resource Graph query for Arc servers with their OS and agent version and compare with src\azure\arc-servers.kql

screens.name: vscode-script
steps: Open the scratch repo (with .github\copilot-instructions.md) and a new Chat or Agent conversation signed in with the owner's GitHub account
Prompt: Write a read-only PowerShell 7 health check for one Windows Server: disks under 15 percent free, automatic services not running, pending reboot, uptime, last hotfix.
Save Copilot's real answer as copilot-draft.ps1 (also copy it to the episode out folder) beside src\scripts\Get-ServerHealth.ps1 and show both
In the VS Code terminal run: pwsh -NoProfile -File <episode>\src\Invoke-AdminGate.ps1 copilot-draft.ps1 and show the findings, whatever they are
Run src\scripts\Get-ServerHealth.ps1 on CON-ARC01 (PowerShell Direct, lab credential typed off camera) and show its output
mask: Windows user name in terminal paths

screens.name: whatif
prepare: foreach ($f in 'copilot-change.ps1','copilot-nowhatif.ps1') { if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path ./out $f))) { throw "Save Copilot's draft as ./out/$f first (demo.md whatif)" } }
screens.note: Only on CON-ARC01. copilot-change.ps1 is Copilot's script for a harmless target (stop and start the Print Spooler on this one server) with SupportsShouldProcess; copilot-nowhatif.ps1 is a draft without it, where -WhatIf must fail. Neither is ever run without -WhatIf.

teardown: Invoke-Command -VMName CON-ARC01 -Credential $cred { Remove-Item C:\lab\ep12, C:\lab\pwsh.msi -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
# manual (owner, on CON-ARC01, elevated): azcmagent disconnect (needs the lab credential)
if ((az group exists --name rg-mglab-copilot-ai-12) -eq 'true') { az group delete --name rg-mglab-copilot-ai-12 --yes --no-wait }
# manual (owner): Hyper-V, stop and delete CON-ARC01 and its VHDX; remove the scratch repo and copilot-draft.ps1; sign out of GitHub in VS Code if personal
